details.description: Missing installation steps and environment requirements
details.why_required: Developers need to know how to set up the project to run it
details.code_evidence: package.json indicates Node.js is required (scripts use 'node'), but no instructions provided

details.description: Missing instructions on how to run the project and what tasks are available
details.why_required: Developers cannot use the tool without knowing the commands and available tasks
details.code_evidence: input.js requires a task name argument, tasks.js defines 'build' and 'test' tasks

details.description: Missing explanation of key modules and their roles
details.why_required: Developers need to understand the code structure to maintain or extend it
details.code_evidence: Project has separate files for input parsing (input.js), task running (taskRunner.js), and task definitions (tasks.js)

details.description: Missing guidance on how to add new tasks
details.why_required: Contributors need to know how to extend the functionality
details.code_evidence: tasks.js exports an object where new tasks can be added as properties
